name: Regent Carlton Cannes
positioning: Belle Epoque hotel on La Croisette Boulevard in Cannes, officially named Carlton Cannes, a Regent Hotel, with interiors by Tristan Auer
best_for: Film lovers who want a stay tied to Hitchcock and cinema
Spa-goers interested in La Prairie treatments
Families and travelers with small dogs

facts.text: The hotel is on La Croisette Boulevard on the French Riviera.
Interior designer Tristan Auer designed the rooms to blend Belle Epoque charm with modern comfort.
Garden view rooms overlook an interior patio planted with local flora.
The Carlton Beach Club serves Franco-Italian dishes.
The Viñales Cigar Lounge is an intimate lounge for cigar lovers.
The fitness centre includes a Pilates zone, boxing and cryotherapy.
The hotel's Experience Agents specialise in cinematic experiences.
Guests can charter a sunset sail or book a helicopter tour over the coast.
Dogs under eight kilos are welcome.
Families can request additional beds or book adjoining rooms.
The cobblestone streets of Le Suquet are a 20-minute stroll away.

highlights.text: Suite 623, the Alfred Hitchcock suite, is where Hitchcock shot To Catch a Thief in 1954.
Le C Club Spa partners with Swiss skincare brand La Prairie.
The Camelia Tea Lounge offers over 30 custom tea blends with a dedicated tea master.
Sea view rooms look out from Port Canto to the Palais des Festivals.

considerations.text: Nice Côte d'Azur Airport is 30 minutes by car; an airport transfer can be arranged on request.
The all-day Camelia Tea Lounge is open to non-guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's ultra-luxury positioning.
